name: nextsaas/faq-answers
title: FAQ answers
description: Question sidebar with category filters, a question search, a live count and a native details accordion.

default.question: What is NextSaas?
default.answer: NextSaas is a connected-workspace website concept for projects, documents, and team conversations. This prototype demonstrates the marketing experience; it is not a live workspace service.

default.question: Where should my team begin?
default.answer: Choose one real project. Gather its brief, owners, and next steps in a single place before expanding to other workflows. The product page shows the intended structure.

default.question: Can I try the workspace here?
default.answer: You can explore the product presentation and interactive page controls. Product screenshots are intentionally reserved for your real assets; there is no connected application or account system.

default.question: Are these prices final?
default.answer: No. The rates on this template are illustrative, not a commercial offer. Monthly and yearly controls demonstrate the intended pricing experience. No payment is collected.

default.question: How does yearly billing work?
default.answer: The example yearly rate is displayed as a monthly equivalent, with the full annual amount shown in the team estimate. Published billing terms must be confirmed before launch.

default.question: Can I discuss a larger team?
default.answer: Yes. Use the contact page and choose a pricing inquiry. In this preview, the form validates locally and does not send your details.

default.question: Can different teams use different views?
default.answer: The concept includes project, document, and collaboration perspectives so teams can organize around the work. Explore the product tabs to see how the story changes.

default.question: Can I bring my existing tools?
default.answer: Connections are part of the product concept, not verified integrations. Confirm supported tools and import formats with your product team before publishing.

default.question: Who can see my projects?
default.answer: The concept separates members, guests, and responsibilities. Actual permission rules depend on the implemented product and should be documented before launch.

default.question: Do these forms store personal information?
default.answer: No. This prototype validates inputs in your browser only. Contact details and newsletter emails are not sent or saved.
